# Payment Setup

Specializes the shared Payment Setup for `myos-customer` and `myos-account-to-account`; other methods are rejected. `resolveParty` accepts a declared role or resolves an account to exactly one declared party/channel, rejecting ambiguous account routing or a missing channel. Recipient details are snapshotted into the instruction. Account-to-account additionally resolves the payer and rejects equal payer/recipient accounts.

The builder selects the MyOS method clause and, for customer funding, uses the customer instruction root with an initiation gate at `/customerSession/funded`. Shared construction retains ordinary active-context, role, amount, identity and destination checks. Customer-session funding, reservation and confirmed transfer are distinct states; local construction does not confirm any of them.
